description: One-time password (OTP) input built on the input-otp library. Composed of InputOTP (root), InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, and InputOTPSeparator for rendering segmented digit inputs with a dot separator variant.
useCases: Two-factor authentication (2FA) code entry in login and verification flows
Email or SMS verification code input during account setup
PIN entry fields for survey access control or respondent verification
